requirement.en: When your opponent Normal Summons a monster, send 1 face-up WATER Attribute monster with 0 or 1500 DEF from your field to the Graveyard.

effect.en: Destroy 1 card on your opponent's field. If you destroyed a Fusion Monster by this effect, you can Special Summon 1 "The Imprisoned Dragon Princess" from your Graveyard face-up to your field. This turn, the monster Special Summoned by this effect cannot be destroyed by battle.
